information_flow: The first call forms one self-contained executable closure and removes construction provenance from its handoff. The final call consumes that complete closure with public obligations but without anchor-policy visibility. A derivable contradiction with those obligations triggers revocation of predecessor semantic authority and obligation-grounded reconstitution within the same single lineage; the final call emits one policy.
name: Contradiction-Triggered Semantic Revocation Relay
organization: two-call sequential lineage with a provenance firewall and one defeasible semantic-authority edge

calls.objective: Form exactly one self-contained executable policy closure from the supplied evidence and public obligations, remove anchor-relative construction provenance from the handoff, and pass the complete executable artifact forward.

Compare represented predecessor commitments with explicit public obligations, retain closure authority absent a derivable incompatibility, or revoke that authority upon such evidence and reconstitute the single artifact under obligation authority, then emit one complete policy.
